message.abstract: <jats:p>This article is concerned with different aspects of spectrahedra and their projections, sets that are important in semidefinite optimization. We prove results on the limitations of so-called Lasserre and theta body relaxation methods for semialgebraic sets and varieties. As a special case we obtain the main result of Netzer, Plaumann, and Schweighofer [SIAM J. Optim., 20 (2010), pp. 1944–1955] on nonexposed faces. We also solve the open problems from that work. We further give a unified account of several results on convex hulls of curves and images of polynomial maps. We finally prove a Positivstellensatz for projections of spectrahedra, which exceeds the known results that only work for basic closed semialgebraic sets.</jats:p>
title: Positive Polynomials and Projections of Spectrahedra
